default/30593.htm.text: Duda-Mara Totem Spirit: Although my eyes have dimmed, I am more aware than you can possibly imagine... The webs of the Duda-Mara span all dimensions of time and space! All events, even those that occur far away, are within my grasp.

Q00416_PathOfTheOrcShaman/30593-01.html.text: Duda-Mara Totem Spirit: Oh-ho! To meet the offspring of Pa'agrio in such a remote land! What do I call you?
